exact_statement: Determine how large n must be as a function of r >= 2 so that there is an antichain in 2^[n] occupying n-3 distinct ranks and containing at least r members on every occupied rank.
scope_notes: Round three begins from commit ab4b524 and the audited round-two refutation of the cubic G++ strengthening; inherited results are evidence only and receive no new promotion credit.

Global closure requires an all-parameter adaptive seed before the rank-42 endpoint for every legal dyadic strip and offset, plus the explicit passage from that seed theorem to the public antichain threshold.
This campaign prioritizes the actual c=1 no-borrow and final (--)->(++) chambers. Finite scans, another fixed-rank subfamily, or a conditional recovery formula do not satisfy the contract.
